description: If a finite clause representation is equivalent to the conjunction of finite premises \(\Gamma\) with \(\neg B\), then \(\Gamma\models B\) if and only if that clause set has a resolution refutation.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.entailment_refutation.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (Γ : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula α)) (B : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula α)
  (L : List (List (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropLiteral α)))
  (h :
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SemEquivalent ((Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.finiteConj Γ.toList).conj B.neg)
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.cnfFormula L)) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Entails Γ B ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.Derives (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.ofCnf L) ∅
